name: Türkiye Sigorta
note: Main sponsor of the Turkish Basketball Federation's national teams since last year; the sponsorship was renewed on 16 February 2026 and its logo is on the back of the women's and men's national teams' jerseys (Sabah, 2026-02-16). The Türkiye Wealth Fund owns 76.1% (turkiye-sigorta-ownership). Tier proposal in the pull request: serious — the state fund controls the sponsor and the fund's parent state (Turkey) has a documented record (turkey-kavala-detention).
